text:
maria: FYI seeing weird cards in console canary — quickinsights sometimes shows another org's panels for a few seconds when switching fast.
ryan: repro steps?
lina: seen it too on canary-2, easy to reproduce with 2 tabs.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: rollout/affinity-signal-opt @ canary-2
maria: repro steps I used: 1) enable new header routing 'x-affinity-tag' 2) open quickinsights for orgA 3) rapidly switch to orgB 4) observe ephemeral cards from orgA inside orgB's view.
ashley: logs attached from console.router (debug):
```
2026-03-20T14:02:01Z console.router INFO route_match org=B header x-aff=orgA cached_key=quickinsights:orgA:card:1234
```
dan: hm cache key includes affinity header but header was dropped downstream and cache lookup used stale entry.
kai: I suspect ordering bug: edge adds header then some proxy strips it before cache keying layer. The cache layer keys on header if present, else falls back to ctx.org — race there.
maria: minimal repro curl sequence I used:
```
curl -H "x-affinity-tag: orgA" https://console.internal/quickinsights?org=orgB
```
pm-jordan: customer-facing note — this can expose data across orgs, potentially PII. We should treat as P0.
eva-sre: set to P0; if reproducible in prod we'll open incident and rollback the canary.
ryan: short-term mitigation: change cache key to always include canonical org_id from auth token (server-side canonical source) and ignore header for keying. Long-term: enforce binding between affinity header and auth principal, and make proxies preserve or reject mismatched headers.
lina: I'll open a PR with unit tests for cache key generation + add an integration test in the e2e-suite that flips headers and asserts no cross-org results.
dan: also add telemetry: console.cache.miskey_count and console.header.mismatch_counter so we can detect regressions in the rollout.
maria: action items: lina PR (cache key fix + tests), eva monitor metrics/alerts, kai audit proxy order, ryan patch runtime keying. I'll pause the canary until we validate.
ryan: pinging @eng-runtime to double-check KV-cache dedupe behavior and any optimizations that may strip header ordering.
maria: ack — will pause canary and revert if we hit >5 cross-org-card events in 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary paused: rollout/affinity-signal-opt (reason: cross-org-panel-detection)
maria: linking repro gist and runbook: https://git.internal/gists/affinity-repro and runbook: https://runbooks.internal/console-crossorg
ashley: FYI the rendering pipeline's function-caller step also reads x-affinity-tag for UI prioritization — need to audit that codepath too.
maria: thanks — quick sync in 30m to coordinate PRs and monitoring. :thumbsup:
